svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "Adenovirus: a non-enveloped DNA virus (causes colds and conjunctivitis)."], [1, "Its genome is linear double-stranded DNA."], [3.5, "A protein capsid with 20 triangular faces (icosahedral) encloses it."], [7, "Twelve fibres stick out from the vertices."], [9.5, "The knobs on the fibres attach to receptors on a host cell."]]
svg.title: Adenovirus structure
svg.desc: A non-enveloped adenovirus: linear double-stranded DNA inside an icosahedral protein capsid of hexons and pentons, with fibres ending in knobs at the 12 vertices.

g.data-info: About 36 000 base pairs, packed inside the capsid with core proteins.
Built from 252 capsomeres: 240 hexons on the faces and 12 pentons at the vertices. 20 triangular faces.
At each of the 12 vertices; the fibre is anchored here.
Project from the 12 vertices; the knob binds a receptor on the host cell surface.
Adenovirus is a non-enveloped virus: the protein capsid is the outer layer.
g.text: no envelope: capsid is the outer layer
